claims.sentence: Patients with history of aspirin sensitivity undergoing coronary angiography are prospectively enrolled.All patients underwent the desensitization procedure with six sequential doses of aspirin (1, 5, 10, 20, 40, and 100 mg) administered orally at predefined intervals, with the procedure lasting 5.5 hours.All patients are followed for desensitization procedure success, description of reactions due to the desensitization procedure, and in hospital major adverse cardiac events (MACE).
